guide.title: User Guide
guide.intro: Sapphire is a local-first networking CRM that helps you manage your professional network: contacts, companies, and every interaction. All data is stored on your device.
guide.section_people_desc: Add and manage your contacts. Each person can be assigned a circle of relation (1 = closest, 4 = outer network), a company, tags, notes, and attachments.
guide.section_circles_desc: Circles let you prioritize your network. Circle 1 = strong connections (mentors, close colleagues), Circle 2 = active network, Circle 3 = extended contacts, Circle 4 = weak ties. Click a circle on the Dashboard to filter the People list.
guide.section_companies_desc: Track companies you are targeting. Companies can have a priority (1–5), sector, size, parent company, associated projects, and employee contacts.
guide.section_actions_desc: Log every interaction: phone calls, emails, LinkedIn messages, meetings, etc. Actions are linked to one or more contacts and have a status (To do / In progress / Done). Use the Calendar view to see upcoming actions.
guide.section_projects_desc: Group your campaigns under projects, such as a job search, a sales prospecting effort, or a set of target clients. A project can be linked to one or more target companies.
guide.section_tags_desc: Tags can be applied to people and companies for quick filtering. Create tags with a custom color directly from the People or Company detail pages.
guide.section_dashboard_desc: The dashboard shows an overview of your network: total contacts, companies, actions, projects, circle distribution, and upcoming actions in the next 7 days.
guide.section_backup_desc: Your database is stored locally. Automatic backups are saved to a "backups" folder next to the database file — this happens automatically, with no separate location to configure. Use Settings > Data to export or import a full JSON dump. The database location itself can be moved to a custom path — a restart is required, and backups will follow it there.
guide.section_shortcuts_desc: Press Ctrl+K (or Cmd+K on Mac) to open the global search from any page. Press N on a list page to quickly add a new entry.

updater.auto_check: Check for updates when Sapphire starts
updater.auto_check_hint: Off by default. When enabled, Sapphire asks GitHub for the latest release version at startup. Nothing else is sent, and updates are never installed automatically.
